summary: The client, Dan Reyes, contacted HomeNet to update his service address to 88 Hill Road and inquire about coverage at that location. The agent confirmed partial coverage but identified lower speeds compared to his current plan due to infrastructure limitations. After discussing options, the agent offered a transfer to a better-equipped plan with adjusted pricing for him. Finally, the client agreed to the transfer and received details via email.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent used the correct greeting and offered a post-call survey.

ratings.name: Personalized the Call
ratings.reason: – The agent correctly addressed Dan with his name and started with “Let me check whether we cover your new address.”

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: – The agent acknowledged Dan’s disappointment by saying "I understand."

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a polite tone, chose words carefully (avoiding harsh language), and kept the conversation focused on resolving the issue.

ratings.name: Paraphrasing
ratings.reason: – The agent restated Dan's concern about speed ("So what are my options?") to confirm understanding.

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: – The agent validated Dan’s name and account details with “Thanks, Dan.”

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: The agent asked a clarifying question about the new address (“What’s the new address?”) to understand the situation better.

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: – The agent clearly stated the next steps (transferring him to a plan and adjusting the price).

ratings.name: Provided the Solution
ratings.reason: – The agent offered a solution – transferring Dan to a lower-speed plan.

ratings.name: Took Ownership
ratings.reason: The agent took responsibility for the issue, even though it was due to infrastructure limitations.

ratings.name: Active Listening
ratings.reason: – The agent listened attentively to Dan’s concerns about speed and price.

ratings.name: Confirmed Resolution
ratings.reason: – The agent confirmed that the transfer would resolve his concern.

suggestions: To maintain their current service at the new address (88 Hill Road).
To have coverage available at the new location.
Confirm the new address is accurate and verify it’s within the service area.
Explore alternative plans that might better suit his needs, considering the lower speeds.

compliance.name: Discourtesy
compliance.rule: Never be discourteous: no profanity, bashing, impatience, or sarcasm toward the customer

compliance.name: Escalation
compliance.rule: Escalate to a supervisor when the customer asks

compliance.name: Call Avoidance
compliance.rule: Do not avoid the call: never refuse to help or push the customer away without a valid reason
